name: play
install: git fetch origin && git merge --ff-only origin/main || true
start: git fetch origin && git merge --ff-only @{u} || true

terminals.name: repo-sync
terminals.command: while true; do git fetch origin && git merge --ff-only @{u} >/tmp/repo-sync.log 2>&1; sleep 60; done
terminals.description: Keep this VM's play checkout fast-forwarded from GitHub.
